sobrietyTitle: A nod to eco-design: turns off the 3D render
lede: From award-winning web experiences to shared solar energy, all the way to teaching. Three worlds, one constant: care for detail.
marquee: Creation — Energy — Teaching — Montpellier — Creative web — Shared solar — Transmission —
epitechBody: Leading the pedagogy of a tech campus: supporting the teams, evolving the curriculum in the age of AI, and connecting every student to the network that will help them grow. The constellation floating behind this text? Nodes linked together — that's exactly the job.
sweenBody: A French pioneer in real-time control of collective solar self-consumption loops (patented technology, now taken over by Sunbiose). The light pulses travelling from building to building? That's the CSC loop: produce local, consume local, live.
troaBody: Bespoke, award-winning web experiences (FWA, Awwwards, Grand Prix Stratégies), eco-designed. I contributed to most of the agency's projects until September 2022. The “eco mode” toggle at the top of the page? A nod to their credo: digital sobriety as a creative act.
epiPageMission: Leading the pedagogy of a tech campus: supporting the teams, evolving the curriculum in the age of AI, and connecting every student to the network that will help them grow.
epiFact1: Supporting and upskilling the campus teaching teams.
epiFact2: Evolving the curriculum as AI reshapes the developer's job.
epiFact3: Connecting students to the local professional network and to real projects.
epiPageContext: Epitech is a French computer science school known for its project-based pedagogy, with no lectures. I lead the pedagogy of the Montpellier campus.
epiPageWhy: A path through an award-winning creative agency and then an industrial startup: I know what the field expects from a developer, and I design the pedagogy accordingly — technical rigour, product mindset, and craft.
swePageMission: Building the platform that controls collective solar self-consumption loops in real time: produce local, consume local, and share the energy across the buildings of a single community.
sweFact1: Real-time control of energy sharing within collective self-consumption loops.
sweFact2: Collecting and exploiting production and consumption data (IoT, metering).
sweFact3: Tools for energy communities and the people who run them.
swePageContext: Sween was a French pioneer in real-time control of collective self-consumption, built on patented technology. A demanding sector: physical constraints, energy regulation, and data that leaves no room for approximation.
swePageAfter: The Sween adventure ended in 2025. The technology, codebase and intellectual property were taken over by Sunbiose, who continue to roll out managed collective self-consumption.
troPageMission: Building bespoke web experiences for demanding brands: strong art direction, carefully crafted motion, and one constraint owned as a feature — eco-design.
troPageProjectsIntro: I contributed to most of the agency's projects until September 2022.
troPageContext: TROA is a creative digital agency in Montpellier, award-winning (FWA, Awwwards, Grand Prix Stratégies), that puts digital sobriety at the heart of its work: cutting needless effects, optimising performance, thinking long term.
troPageLegacy: An award-winning agency's standard for detail — and the conviction that a constraint, here eco-design, is a creative driver rather than a brake. This very site is its direct continuation.
